engine_design_parameters.pillar_1_regime_saturation: Anchor (14,14) + Macro (9,9) must both be same direction

pillar_2_time_in_position.method: Anchor+Macro regime duration counter with slow decay (not hard reset) on mixed states

pillar_3_volume_exhaustion.method: 3-bar rolling average of Rel-Volume near range extremes

alert_priority_levels: CRITICAL: All 4 pillars aligned (score 90-100) = Trade NOW
HIGH: 3 pillars aligned, 1 approaching (score 70-89) = Active Watch
MEDIUM: Regime exhausted but no volume/spark yet (score 40-69) = On Radar
LOW: Regime building, not yet exhausted (score 0-39) = Background Monitor
